name: presentations
description: Design, build, review, export, and theme multi-slide HTML presentations with brand presets

interface.shortDescription: Build and perfect HTML slide decks with brand presets
interface.longDescription: Five skills covering the full presentation lifecycle: designing-presentations plans the content into a deck.md storyboard, creating-presentations renders and perfects multi-slide HTML decks styled from brand presets with a two-window presenter view, editing-presentations runs a local editor where the user clicks slide elements and the agent reads the selection, exporting-presentations-to-pptx converts a finished deck into native editable PowerPoint, and extracting-presets turns brand material into reusable presets.
defaultPrompt: Build a presentation from this document
